symptom: `alter navigation Responsive { insert { menu item 'Helpdesk chat' ( OnClick: show page Helpdesk.Chat ) } };` run twice left two 'Helpdesk chat' items, and the second run reported 'Altered navigation Responsive' instead of Unchanged.
cause: InsertMenuItems spliced the built items in unconditionally; insert is the one menu operation whose second application is not a no-op.
insight: **An insert is re-runnable when 'already there' means 'already there as this statement builds it', compared without element ids and with the stored captions kept to the languages the statement writes.** Same caption and same content in the target list: dropped, so the patch write is elided and the run reports Unchanged. Same caption, different content (action, sub-items): refused naming `replace`, because inserting leaves two items of one caption and skipping drops the change. Comparing by caption alone would have silently ignored an edited action on re-run. Live on 11.12.6: run 1 Altered, run 2 Unchanged, one item; the edited OnClick is refused before anything is written; mx check 0 errors.
